contract.proposition: The Fed decreases rates by at least 50 basis points after its September 2024 meeting

market.title: Fed decreases interest rates by 50+ bps after September 2024 meeting?
market.rules: YES if the upper bound of the federal-funds target range falls by at least 50 basis points after the September 2024 meeting.

cards.title: July jobs report shows a sharp hiring slowdown
claims: Payroll employment rose by 114,000 in July and unemployment increased to 4.3%.
cards.mechanism: A weaker labor market increases the case for front-loading rate cuts, including a half-point move.

cards.title: July CPI confirms further disinflation
claims: Headline CPI rose 0.2% in July and 2.9% over twelve months; core CPI rose 0.2%.
cards.mechanism: Continued disinflation gives the FOMC more room to respond forcefully to labor-market weakness.

cards.title: Powell says the time has come to adjust policy
claims: Powell said the time had come for policy to adjust and emphasized downside employment risks.

sources.title: Review and Outlook
sources.timestampMeaning: Release-on-delivery time of 10:00 a.m. EDT in the official speech PDF, not the HTML footer Last Update date.

cards.mechanism: An explicit pivot confirms a September cut and leaves the opening move’s size responsive to incoming labor data.

cards.title: August adds 142,000 jobs; earlier months revised lower
claims: Payrolls rose by 142,000 in August, prior months were revised lower, and unemployment was 4.2%, little changed.
cards.mechanism: Weak revisions support a larger cut, while the unemployment decline reduces the urgency for an emergency-sized move.

cards.title: August core inflation rises 0.3%
claims: Headline CPI rose 0.2% in August while core CPI rose 0.3%.
cards.mechanism: A firmer core reading weakens the case for a half-point cut at the immediately following meeting.

ending.title: The FOMC cuts by 50 basis points
ending.text: The September 18, 2024 FOMC statement records a 50-basis-point reduction; the exact contract resolved YES. This is reveal-only and is not a scored card.

contract.proposition: Will the Los Angeles Dodgers win the 2025 World Series?

market.title: Will the Los Angeles Dodgers win the 2025 World Series?
market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2025 MLB World Series. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the World Series based on the rules of the MLB (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoff bracket), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2025  MLB season is permanently canceled or has not been completed by February 28, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.
